title: connect_shapes
description: Draw a connector (a line, an arrow) from one shape to another, attached to both, between the sides that face each other: to link the boxes of a diagram. The result gives the connector's shape ID.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.

from_shape_id.description: Where it starts, from the deck map.

to_shape_id.description: Where it ends (the arrow's point), from the deck map.

like_connector_id.description: A connector of the diagram to look like (its colour, width, dash). Left out: the line most of the slide's connectors have, else the theme's.

kind.description: Left out: straight when the shapes are in line, else an elbow.

arrow.description: "end" (the default): an arrowhead where it ends; "both": at both ends; "none": a plain line.
